source.note: Written for live-mix (U16): a lookahead brickwall limiter whose detector is the ITU-R BS.1770-4 Annex 2 four-phase true-peak FIR, the same coefficients src/core/analysis/loudness.ts uses for the meter. true_peak_limiter.h is the header-only DSP; true_peak_limiter_device.* and device_api.cpp are the stereo-bus wrapper and ABI shim.
